title: Press Shop Operator / Setter
summary: Set and run power presses from 20 to 250 tonnes across progressive, deep-draw and trim tooling.
responsibilities: Set dies and run production on power presses from 20 to 250 tonnes
Complete first-article checks and in-process dimensional checks
Monitor tool condition and report drift or damage to the tool room early
Maintain output, scrap and downtime records for each shift
Work safely and keep the press area to standard
requirements: ITI or equivalent, or demonstrable press shop experience
Experience setting progressive or deep-draw dies
Able to use verniers, micrometers and basic gauges confidently
Strong safety awareness around power presses and die handling
